description:
WE ARE HIRING!Sales & Marketing Executive – HoReCa Division

**Company:** Mithash Foods Pvt. Ltd.  
**Website:** https://mithashnutri.com/  
**Location:** Atkot, Rajkot, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Field Sales + Office Work

**Job Location : 1.Surat**  
**2,Ahamdabad**

**3,Atkot**

About the Role

Mithash Foods Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Marketing Executive to expand our HoReCa business. The candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and building strong relationships with hotels, restaurants, cafés, caterers and other food-service businesses.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop new customers in the HoReCa segment.
* Visit hotels, restaurants, cafés, bakeries, caterers and commercial kitchens.
* Promote and sell company products, including spices, flours, pulses, rice, cooking oil, sauces and other food essentials.
* Generate leads, arrange product samples and follow up on quotations.
* Build relationships with chefs, purchase managers, hotel owners and restaurant owners.
* Develop bulk orders, repeat business and long-term customer relationships.
* Identify distributors, wholesalers and institutional buyers.
* Conduct market research and track competitor pricing.
* Maintain customer databases, sales reports and monthly targets.

Requirements

* Qualification: Graduate or equivalent; candidates with relevant sales experience are preferred.
* Experience in FMCG, food products, HoReCa or B2B sales will be an advantage.
* Good communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Willingness to travel for field visits and customer meetings.
* Knowledge of the local market and Gujarati/Hindi communication is preferred.
* Freshers with strong sales skills may also apply.

What We Offer

* Fixed salary + performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to grow with an expanding food business.
* Career growth in B2B and HoReCa sales.
* Exposure to hotels, restaurants, cafés and institutional customers.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹33,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
